_readme: Copy to profile.json and fill in. profile.json is gitignored - never commit it. Every value below is a placeholder.
titles_match: List the exact job titles you want
e.g. ML Engineer Intern, Machine Learning Intern, Applied AI Intern

search_vocabulary._note: The single highest-leverage field. Give 3+ phrasings per concept. Sites match very differently - see the vocabulary table in SKILL.md.
alternate_phrasings: category name a board might use
avoid: words that swamp the match on some boards, e.g. 'fresher' or 'internship' alone

evidence_bank._note: One entry per project or role, written as a single factual sentence with a number in it where possible. These get quoted into applications, so they must be true and specific. 'Built an X that did Y, measured at Z' beats 'experienced in X'.

known_gaps._note: List what you do NOT have. The skill states these honestly in every recorded role rather than hiding them. This is a feature - it stops you wasting applications and stops the tool inflating your resume.

must_match_any_keyword: keywords that must appear somewhere in the listing
flag_dont_reject: CGPA cutoff above yours - many are guidelines, flag as a stretch
Masters preferred - flag as a stretch

bonus_signals: JD phrases that mean an unusually good match for you specifically

pay_floor._note: Run the market survey in SKILL.md Phase 1 BEFORE committing to a floor. In some fields a floor of 25000/month removes the entire market rather than the bottom of it. Know which case you are in.

digest._note: Leave blank to write digests to file only. Setting this makes the skill email you - it never emails employers.
